exp.desc:
- Purchase ledger for three companies (c. 1,200 invoices/month)
- Payment runs and discounts
- VAT returns, month-end support

cv.hobbies: Walking on the Downs, treasurer of a sports club
cv.name: Sarah Mills
cv.title: Accounts assistant

cl.p1: Around 1,200 supplier invoices cross my desk every month, and I make sure they are coded, approved and paid on time – we almost never miss an early-payment discount.
cl.p2: At a wholesaler with three companies I run purchase ledger and payments, prepare VAT returns and support month-end with accruals and reconciliations. When we moved to digital invoice approval, I mapped the approval routes with each department; processing time almost halved.
cl.p3: I am starting an advanced accounting qualification this autumn. My notice period is six weeks.

cl.p1: For seven years at an accountancy practice I kept the books for around 40 clients, from a bakery to an engineering firm. I now want to work in-house and really understand one business.
cl.p2: I produce management accounts, VAT returns and year-end working papers, and I know construction specifics such as stage payments and the reverse charge. I have also chased overdue invoices – politely and firmly.
